description: 555 phoenix firebirds rising from the ashes. 6 legendary rares. Each Firebird carries a story of destruction and rebirth.
network_suggestion: Ethereum (ERC-721) or Solana (Metaplex) — choose at launch
note: This folder is a launchable STARTER pack: 6 legendary rares + 8 destruction-themed artworks (used across the 549 non-rares) + 1 logo. The full 555 supply is generated procedurally in the app (each token gets one of these artworks + its own story + traits + realistic floor price). Suitable for launch on Ethereum (ERC-721) or Solana (Metaplex).

themed_art.title: Wings of Nations
themed_art.story: A great eagle takes the phoenix's fire. Its burning wings carry the colors of fallen nations — a quiet warning that no empire is eternal.

themed_art.title: Under the Wings
themed_art.story: Beneath the phoenix's shadow, the Earth begins to glow. One beat of these wings and coastlines turn to embers. Beauty and ruin share the same breath.

themed_art.title: Grip of Fire
themed_art.story: An eagle-phoenix clutches a cracked, burning world. What it holds, it can save — or set alight. The choice was never ours.

themed_art.title: Molten Ascension
themed_art.story: From the throat of an erupting mountain, the firebird climbs. Every eruption is only the world remembering how to begin again.

themed_art.title: Warning of Rebirth
themed_art.story: The old phoenix crumbles to white ash as a new one is born from its core. A warning written in fire — even intelligence must burn to be reborn.

themed_art.title: The Descent
themed_art.story: A colossal firebird falls upon a sleeping city. Rivers of flame fill the streets. By dawn, only the story remains.

themed_art.title: Ashen Dawn
themed_art.story: Over a smoldering battlefield the phoenix waits for sunrise. Faint banners burn in the distance. Endings, too, can be gentle.

themed_art.title: Firestorm
themed_art.story: Walls of flame close in, and still the firebird flies. It does not fear the storm — it is the storm.

rares.name: Firebird #001 — Sovereign Ember
rares.story: The first flame. Sovereign Ember remembers every empire it has reduced to ash. Where its crown of fire passes, thrones melt and kingdoms are rewritten. It does not rule the fire — it IS the fire.

rares.name: Firebird #088 — Cosmic Flame
rares.story: Born between dying stars, Cosmic Flame carries the heat of collapsing suns. Whole worlds have gone dark in the wake of its wings — not out of malice, but because rebirth demands an ending.

rares.name: Firebird #111 — Cybernetic Phoenix
rares.story: Half machine, half fire. The Cybernetic Phoenix was forged when a dying network chose to burn itself alive rather than be controlled. A warning wrapped in chrome and flame.

rares.name: Firebird #333 — Golden Ash
rares.story: From the ruins of a golden city rose Golden Ash. Everything it touches turns first to gold, then to ash. Greed and glory are the same fire in different light.

rares.name: Firebird #444 — Nebula Wing
rares.story: Nebula Wing spreads galaxies across the void with a single beat. Beautiful, silent, and final — for behind that beauty burns the memory of everything it has already consumed.

rares.name: Firebird #555 — Eternal Rebirth
rares.story: The last and the first. As the old phoenix burns, Eternal Rebirth is born from its white-hot core — a warning and a promise: nothing truly ends, it only begins again in fire.
